0022600030.text: The Bucks, 1-7 and on a four-game losing streak, host the Raptors, 4-4 and coming off a loss, in Milwaukee's ninth game of the season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Milwaukee sits 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, 5 games back, with a 1-3 home record, while Toronto is 5th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, with a 2-1 home record. Kam Jones (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision for Milwaukee, while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Kyle Anderson (illness) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 122-94 loss in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
